create_slab_from_bulk_random: create a Slab object by randomly sampling a slab from a given Bulk structure
create_slab_from_specific_millers: create Slab objects for specific Miller indices from a given Bulk structure
create_slabs_from_bulk_all: create all symmetrically distinct Slab objects up to a max Miller index from a Bulk
create_slab_from_precomputed_pkl: create Slab objects by loading precomputed slabs from a pickle file
compute_slabs_from_bulk: compute all symmetrically distinct slabs for a bulk structure with a given max Miller index
